info.description:
Auto-generated Postman collection from the OpenAPI 3.0 spec. See http://localhost:4000/api/docs (Swagger UI) or the OpenAPI JSON at http://localhost:4000/api/docs.json for the live spec.

Two baseUrl variables are pre-set: `{{baseUrl}}` (default http://localhost:4000) and `{{locale}}` (default "en"). Use the versioned prefix `/api/v1/{{locale}}` or the legacy `/api` — both work. After login, set `{{token}}` from the accessToken.
